msg: Pick a gnome at random at first and aim for the highest number. If it is +4 or +5 at least, then stick with the gnome with the same hat for as long as you can until it drops down to 1 or 0. Then switch to the other gnome/other hat. The colours don't seem to make a lot of difference and if you lose track of which gnome then just try and figure out which one seems to be scoring best and then stick with that one. Remember you have to be quick and remember to press the space bar when the basket appears. Good luck!
